product.name: Interview Intelligence Platform
product.description: A platform that integrates with ATS to streamline the interview process, offering features like recording, transcribing interviews, AI-powered notes, and highlights for improved hiring decisions.

product.name: AI-powered Interview Notes
product.description: Automatically generates detailed notes from interviews, allowing hiring teams to focus on candidates and make informed decisions quickly.

product.name: AI Interview Insights and Coaching
product.description: Provides interview insights and AI-driven coaching to improve interviewer skills and the overall candidate experience.

product.name: Seamless ATS Integration
product.description: Offers integrations with applicant tracking systems, video conferencing, and collaboration tools for a streamlined workflow.

product.name: Automated Interview Summaries
product.description: Generates summaries of interviews, capturing key details for better hiring decisions and reducing preparation time.

product.description: Uses AI to quickly create inclusive job descriptions and structured interview plans, saving time and improving quality of hire.
